note: Commerce Wishlist = save-for-later for Drupal Commerce. Entities: commerce_wishlist (list), commerce_wishlist_item (line), commerce_wishlist_type (config bundle, ships 'default'). Global config commerce_wishlist.settings: allow_multiple, allow_anonymous_sharing, duplicate, default_type (='default'), view_modes; edited at /admin/commerce/config/wishlist-settings. Services: commerce_wishlist.wishlist_provider (getWishlist/createWishlist), commerce_wishlist.wishlist_manager (addEntity/removeWishlistItem/emptyWishlist/merge). 'Add to wishlist' is injected into the Commerce add-to-cart form and product-variation field formatters (third-party settings show_wishlist/weight_wishlist/label_wishlist/region). Wishlist block id commerce_wishlist. Permissions: access wishlist, administer commerce_wishlist_type, + Commerce-generated entity perms. Medium cases toggle a known setting and read it back; hard cases set a setting (verified in config) and create a wishlist type (verified as a config entity). NOTE for scripts: drush cset with the literal 'false' does NOT store boolean false on this site (use 0); 'true' works.

evals.prompt: In Drupal Commerce Wishlist, which configuration setting lets a single customer have more than one wishlist, and where is it configured?
evals.expected_output: commerce_wishlist.settings:allow_multiple (default false). Configure it on the Wishlist settings form at /admin/commerce/config/wishlist-settings, or drush cset commerce_wishlist.settings allow_multiple true.

evals.prompt: In Drupal Commerce Wishlist, which service and method do I use to add a purchasable entity (e.g. a product variation) to a wishlist in code?
evals.expected_output: Use the commerce_wishlist.wishlist_manager service (WishlistManager) and call addEntity($wishlist, $purchasable_entity, $quantity, $combine, $save). Resolve/create the $wishlist first with commerce_wishlist.wishlist_provider (getWishlist/createWishlist).

evals.prompt: What entity types does the Commerce Wishlist module define, and which one is the configurable bundle/type?
evals.expected_output: commerce_wishlist (the list), commerce_wishlist_item (a line referencing a purchasable entity + quantity), and commerce_wishlist_type (a config bundle/type, ships a 'default' type with an allowAnonymous flag).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, does Commerce Wishlist currently allow customers to have multiple wishlists? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — commerce_wishlist.settings:allow_multiple is true (drush cget commerce_wishlist.settings allow_multiple).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is anonymous sharing of wishlists enabled in Commerce Wishlist? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
On this Drupal site, configure Commerce Wishlist so that a single customer can have more than one wishlist. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: commerce_wishlist.settings:allow_multiple becomes TRUE (drush cset commerce_wishlist.settings allow_multiple true -y, or via the settings form / config API).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new Commerce Wishlist type with machine name 'cw_gift' and label 'Gift Registry' that allows anonymous wishlists. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A commerce_wishlist_type config entity 'cw_gift' exists with label 'Gift Registry' and allowAnonymous = TRUE. E.g. create it via the commerce_wishlist_type storage or /admin/commerce/config/wishlists (add wishlist type).
